playbookOutputs: Bargaining council employer registration confirmation with employer number
Employee membership confirmation / member list acknowledged by the council's provident fund administrator
Guidance note on monthly council returns and provident fund contributions
playbookCommonFailures: Wrong bargaining council — the client's industry or region falls outside the council's scope (the catalogue does not say which 'NBC' this is)
Employee certified IDs missing or certified more than 3 months ago
Employee details incomplete (no job grade / occupation, start date or wage, which the council needs to set the contribution rate)
Proof of business address older than 3 months or not a municipal account
Employer already registered with the council under a previous owner or trading name

informationToProvide.label: Company registration documents (e.g., CIPC COR14.3)
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC CoR14.3 (or CK1/CK2) showing the registered name, enterprise number and directors. The employer registered with the council is the company.

informationToProvide.label: Certified ID copies of all employees to be registered - not older than 3 months
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.
alternatives: Certified passport and work permit for a foreign employee

informationToProvide.label: Proof of business address (Municipal bill, rates and Taxes -  not older than 3 months
informationToProvide.aiHint: Municipal rates / taxes account or utility bill in the company's name dated within 3 months, showing the physical address where the employees work (the council's scope is regional).

informationToProvide.label: Employee details (full names, ID numbers, contact info)
informationToProvide.aiHint: List of employees with full names, ID numbers, cell number / email, occupation or job grade, date of engagement and basic wage. Job grade and wage matter because council contribution rates are set per grade.

informationToProvide.label: Contact information for all directors (email and contact)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Email address and cell number for each director on the CoR14.3; the council writes to the directors when confirming the registration.

informationToProvide.label: Which bargaining council / provident fund the business falls under
informationToProvide.aiHint: Ask the client which council they have been told to register with (e.g. a national bargaining council for their industry) and which region. If they do not know, capture the industry and province so Kevin can determine scope.

informationToProvide.label: Business Bank Confirmation Letter (In the Company Name, Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload an official bank confirmation letter (< 3 months) in the company name for NBC Provident Fund contribution debit/EFT setup.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official bank account confirmation letter from a registered SA bank in the company legal name, dated within 90 days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect bargaining council registration requirements
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR14.3, proof of address, director contacts, complete employee list and a certified ID for every employee received; council identified
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: This service registers a Contract Cleaning employer and its employees with the Contract Cleaning National Provident Fund (administered by NBC Holdings under Sectoral Determination 6 / BCCCI). Chase any missing documents: CoR 14.3, certified IDs (< 3 months) for directors and every employee, proof of business address, bank confirmation letter, and the employee wage/grade schedule.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify employer and employee documents
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All required uploads pass the rules engine or are approved by Kevin; every employee on the list has a certified ID
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: CoR14.3 and proof of address in the company's name. Match every employee ID copy to a row in the employee list by ID number; run the SA ID checksum; certification within 90 days. Extract enterprise number, physical address (and province), director contacts, employee count and per-employee wage / occupation. Flag any employee whose address or role suggests they fall outside the council's scope.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft council employer registration form values and POA
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Hand-off sheet with the council's employer application fields and employee schedule, plus POA, posted for Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Prepare a hand-off sheet mirroring the council's employer registration form (employer name, trading name, CIPC number, PAYE / UIF / COIDA numbers if known, physical address, sector, number of employees, commencement date) and an employee schedule (name, ID, occupation / grade, wage, start date). ⚠ verify the actual council form name once Kevin confirms the council. Draft a Special POA on My Accountant letterhead authorising Kevin Freese (CIBA #3561) to register the employer and employees. Never invent a wage or grade — leave blank and flag.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send registration form and POA to client for signature
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed council form(s) and POA uploaded by client
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the approved forms with plain instructions: a director signs the employer application and POA; where the council's form has an employee declaration, each employee signs their own section. Return as PDF.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Email registration pack to the bargaining council
fulfillmentChecklist.expectedReply: Council acknowledgement with an employer number and member confirmation
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Submit the signed NBC Contract Cleaning National Provident Fund employer & member registration forms, employee schedule, certified IDs, CoR 14.3, proof of address, bank confirmation letter, and POA to NBC Holdings (confirm regional NBC email/portal with Kevin prior to dispatch).

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for council confirmation and follow up
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Employer number and employee membership confirmation received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Follow up quoting the acknowledgement reference. If the council queries scope (industry / region) or an employee's grade, create a proposal for Kevin with the query text.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver council registration confirmation to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Employer number and member confirmation posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the confirmation and explain in plain English that monthly council returns and provident fund contributions are now due for the registered employees. Offer the monthly payroll service.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
